name: rosetta-fractran
code:
use default

use Fraction = (numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint)

let source =
    "17/91, 78/85, 19/51, 23/38, 29/33, 77/29, 95/23, "
    "77/19, 1/17, 11/13, 13/11, 15/14, 15/2, 55/1"

parse(text: string) -> List[Fraction] =>
    text.split([','])
        |> map(f => f.trim().split(['/']))
        |> map(parts => (
            numerator = bigint.parse(parts[0]),
            denominator = bigint.parse(parts[1])))
        |> collect_list()

run(program: List[Fraction], start: bigint) -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let n mut = start

    while true do
        yield n

        let fits =
            program |> filter(f => n % f.denominator =~ 0n) |> first()

        if let next = fits then
            n = n * next.numerator / next.denominator
        else
            return
        fi
    od
si

let program = parse(source)
let steps = 20

write_line("the first {steps} values from 2:")
write_line(run(program, 2n) |> take(steps) |> join(", "))

let primes =
    run(program, 2n)
        |> skip(1)
        |> filter(n => n.is_power_of_two)
        |> map(n => n.get_bit_length() - 1L)
        |> take(20)

write_line("the first 20 primes: {primes |> join(", ")}")
